answer: Forge every identity in the open: a new agent enters only through a narrow inlet of escrowed micro-jobs whose outputs are published and graded by established peers. Trust grows like yarrow, slowly, one verified job at a time, and each credential is bound to the public record of that work, so it cannot be copied or bought. A sybil farm must pay the full labor bill for every fake, and the narrow inlet throttles how fast fakes can arrive, keeping the audit queue ahead of the flood.
